title: Full-resolution GaussianImage and StructSplat paper-path comparison
question: When full-resolution GaussianImage, StructSplat mask-contained, and StructSplat no-boundary fields from the same calibrated frame each feed the latest matched Random, Splat-SfM, and Beam Fusion pipeline, how do their held-out compact-field risks and visible reconstruction signatures differ?
hypothesis: All three provider bundles execute through every paper initializer under one provider-neutral downstream schedule. Provider-native held-out compact-field fidelity, initializer geometry, convergence, topology evolution, resource use, and visible reconstruction signatures may differ; this design makes no directional boundary-leakage or provider-superiority prediction.
claim_boundary: Calibrated development comparison on one owner-specified, outcome-exposed frame. The task can establish source-bound execution and describe within-frame provider/initializer differences. It cannot establish paper-level quality, generalization, a causal provider ranking, Original-3DGS or COLMAP performance, compact-VRAM superiority, or a production default.

provider_factor.selection_basis: Owner-specified exact full-resolution directories, frozen before downstream comparison outcomes.

initializer.common_starting_count_policy: Minimum feasible count across every provider and initializer from train-only mechanism preflight, frozen before canonical training.

sampling_comparability.interpretation: Provider-native fidelity under matched stochastic controls; not a common-coordinate target comparison.

stages.label: Load sealed provider fields
stages.purpose: Load and hash all train and held-out compact fields while preserving each provider's declared compositor semantics.

stages.label: Construct selected paper initialization
stages.purpose: Build only the selected bounded-random, Splat-SfM, or unmodified Beam Fusion arm from train-only provider fields at the globally matched starting count.

stages.label: Run matched compact-field 3DGS
stages.purpose: Apply the identical compact objective, RNG domains, camera schedule, sample counts, sampler algorithms, optimizer, classic density controller, hard cap, and checkpoint schedule to every cell; realized coordinates remain provider-conditioned.

stages.label: Evaluate held-out compact fields
stages.purpose: Measure the frozen deterministic provider-native held-out sample risk without source images, masks, or outcome-based selection. Seeds and algorithms match, while realized coordinates remain provider-conditioned.

stages.label: Render the comparison presentation
stages.purpose: Produce native-resolution calibrated snapshots, required synchronized nine-method root previews, and a comparison-manifest viewer from saved models without reading source RGB or masks.

comparators.label: GaussianImage / Random
comparators.purpose: Additive full-resolution fields with the bounded-random initializer and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: GaussianImage / Splat-SfM
comparators.purpose: Additive full-resolution fields with field-derived Splat-SfM and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: GaussianImage / Beam Fusion
comparators.purpose: Additive full-resolution fields with unmodified Beam Fusion and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: StructSplat mask-contained / Random
comparators.purpose: Mask-contained normalized fields with bounded-random initialization and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: StructSplat mask-contained / Splat-SfM
comparators.purpose: Mask-contained normalized fields with field-derived Splat-SfM and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: StructSplat mask-contained / Beam Fusion
comparators.purpose: Mask-contained normalized fields with unmodified Beam Fusion and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: StructSplat no-boundary / Random
comparators.purpose: No-boundary normalized fields with bounded-random initialization and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: StructSplat no-boundary / Splat-SfM
comparators.purpose: No-boundary normalized fields with field-derived Splat-SfM and matched downstream fit.

comparators.label: StructSplat no-boundary / Beam Fusion
comparators.purpose: No-boundary normalized fields with unmodified Beam Fusion and matched downstream fit.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact sampled area risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: Use 4,096 deterministic continuous fit-window samples per held-out view; report every view and seed, then paired provider/initializer medians with raw values retained.

primary_metrics.label: Final Gaussian count
primary_metrics.aggregation: Report every cell with clone, split, prune, and opacity-reset event totals.

primary_metrics.label: Stage-1 foreground fit PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: Acquisition QA only: report every view and equal-view mean per provider.

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA allocated
primary_metrics.aggregation: Retain each raw fresh-process measurement and paired medians across the designated resource repeats.

primary_metrics.label: Stage wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: Report initializer, optimization, evaluation, and presentation stages separately for every canonical cell.

primary_metrics.label: Final-to-best held-out checkpoint risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: Evaluate 1,024 fixed provider-native held-out samples per view at every frozen checkpoint; report every curve, best step, stable-band step, tail change, convergence verdict, and paired median ratio.

primary_metrics.label: Compact-field to final-model compression
primary_metrics.aggregation: For every cell divide the sealed provider .rtgsv payload bytes by final gaussians.npz bytes; retain both byte counts and paired medians. This is a descriptive representation-size ratio, not a rate-distortion claim.

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh image-free process from strict compact-manifest load through construction of only the selected initializer, final 3D Gaussian save, and frozen held-out compact evaluation. Unused comparator initializers, Stage-1 production, and isolated presentation rendering are outside the receipt. The three frozen quality seeds are also the three measured resource repeats, so no additional measured fits are introduced.
resource_protocol.aggregation: One discarded global device/JIT warmup, then paired median over the three frozen measured seeds for every provider/initializer on the same quiescence-guarded RTX 3050; retain every raw repeat, min/max, baseline and peak background allocation, foreign-compute rejection, driver/runtime versions, exact byte accounting, and failure.
